n_home.text: HOME. Opens straight onto the work, no intro copy. 8–12 projects on a slow ring; drag, wheel or arrow keys turn it with momentum and it settles on the nearest piece. Front piece = largest; its name and facts swap in bottom-left. Click front piece → it expands into the case study (shared-element transition). Ring / Index toggle bottom-right.

n_index.text: WORK INDEX. The full archive. Filters by sector and discipline (instant, no reload). Two views: List (names large, image follows the cursor) and Grid (4:5 images, name on hover). Every row is a fact line: N°, client, sector, discipline, year.

n_case.text: CASE STUDY. Show, don't tell: full-bleed hero, one fact strip, then images and film in an editorial rhythm (full, 2-up, offset). One finding line is the only prose. Credits, then Next project pulls the next hero up as you scroll to the end.

n_studio.text: STUDIO. The team and method, shown through images of the process rather than paragraphs: studio photos, the five-step method as a strip of real artefacts, client logos, people cropped faceless-to-portrait, press.

n_services.text: SERVICES. Each discipline sells itself with 3 pieces of work. Tapping a discipline opens its row (accordion) and filters the work thumbnails. One line per service; the proof is the images.

n_lab.text: LAB. Experiments, type studies, motion tests, the Recap archive. A dense masonry of loops and stills; hover plays a loop. This is where the studio plays in public.

n_contact.text: CONTACT. Short and direct: a four-field brief form, email and Instagram, city and local time. Sends to the studio inbox; success state replaces the form in place.

n_404.text: 404. The ring, jumbled. A 'Back to the work' link rebuilds it. A small reward for the curious.

n_mob.text: MOBILE. Same content, touch-first: the ring becomes a horizontal swipe with snap; the index is a single column; case studies stack full-width; the menu is a full-screen sheet. Every interaction has a reduced-motion version.
